# Benchmark suites handed to CodSpeed, shared by both workflows:
#   tests.yml           runs these with -m benchmark_high_impact on every PR
#   full-benchmarks.yml runs all benchmarks in these directories, weekly
#
# Do not replace this list with a glob over
# tests/src/core_pdf/impl/**/benchmarks. Two directories match that
# pattern on a developer machine but hold no tracked files -- s_07_document and
# s_07_objects, whose benchmark modules were deleted by the layering refactor in
# #49 and survive locally only as stale __pycache__. A fresh CI clone does not
# have them, and pytest exits with "file or directory not found" on a path that
# does not exist, so globbing would break both workflows.
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/render/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/output/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/writing/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_07_content/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_07_filters/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_07_syntax/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_07_syntax_primitives/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_07_security/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_08_graphics/benchmarks
tests/src/core_pdf/impl/spec/s_09_fonts/benchmarks
